--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,39 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validation
+    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
+                      (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
+                      (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a numpy array')
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a two-dimensional matrix')
+        if arr.size == 0:
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} must not be empty')
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} must contain only finite values')
+        if np.any(arr > 0):
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} must contain only nonpositive values')
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError('All input matrices must have the same shape')
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError('tau_filter must not be a boolean')
+    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
+        raise ValueError('tau_filter must be a numeric value')
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError('tau_filter must be finite')
+    if tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError('tau_filter must be nonnegative')
+
+    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
+    t = np.arange(horizon)
+    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
+    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
+    L_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, norm_weights)
+    L_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, norm_weights)
+    L_no_call = -np.dot(logp_no_call, norm_weights)
+    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
+    margin = L_minus - L_plus
+    keep = margin >= tau_filter
+    return keep, margin
